days.title: Day 1: Pets and Farm Animals
days.description: Знакомимся с домашними питомцами и сельскохозяйственными животными

grammar.title: Tag-questions (разделительные вопросы)
grammar.rule:
📘 **Tag-questions** — это вопросы в конце предложения, чтобы уточнить информацию.

📝 **Формула**:
✅ Утверждение + короткий вопрос с противоположным знаком.

✅ You like dogs, **don't you?**
✅ She has got a cat, **hasn't she?**
✅ They aren't noisy, **are they?**

📝 **Краткие ответы**:
✅ Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

🎯 **Мем**: 'You have a pet, don't you?' — 'Yes, I do. It's a potato.' 🥔

exercises.explanation: Budgies are birds, not fish! 🐦

exercises.question: Cows give milk, do they?
exercises.explanation: Cows give milk (утверждение) → don't they? (отрицательный вопрос) 🐄

grammar.title: Tag-questions с have got
grammar.rule:
📘 **Tag-questions с have got**:

✅ You have got a dog, **haven't you?**
✅ She has got a cat, **hasn't she?**
✅ They haven't got a pet, **have they?**

📝 **Ответы**:
✅ Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

🎯 **Примеры**:
❓ You have got a pet, haven't you?
✅ Yes, I have. I've got a cute cat.

❓ She hasn't got a pet, has she?
✅ No, she hasn't. But she wants a dog!

days.title: Day 3: Describing Your Pet
days.description: Учимся описывать питомца — цвет, размер, особенности

grammar.title: Tag-questions с to be
grammar.rule:
📘 **Tag-questions с to be**:

✅ It is cute, **isn't it?**
✅ They are playful, **aren't they?**
✅ He isn't noisy, **is he?**

📝 **Ответы**:
✅ Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.

🎯 **Мем**:
❓ My dog is the cutest, isn't it?
✅ Yes, it is! But my cat is cuter! 🐱

days.title: Day 4: Reading — Pets in the Chat Forum
days.description: Читаем сообщения в форуме о домашних питомцах

grammar.title: Чтение и понимание текста
grammar.rule:
📚 **Стратегия чтения**:
1️⃣ Прочитай текст целиком, чтобы понять общий смысл.
2️⃣ Найди, у кого какой питомец.
3️⃣ Прочитай вопросы и найди ответы в тексте.

💡 **Совет**: Обрати внимание на tag-questions в диалогах!

exercises.question: What is Chris's pet? 🐦
exercises.explanation: Chris says: 'My budgie has got blue, grey and white feathers.' 🐦
exercises.readingText:
🌟 PETS IN THE CHAT FORUM 🌟

Welcome to the 'English by Weeks' pet forum! Share your pets here! 👇

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🐦 CHRIS: (10:35)
Hi everyone! I'm Chris. I like cats, but I haven't got one. I think budgies are the best! My budgie has got blue, grey and white feathers and a little yellow beak. His name is Tweety and he sings all day long. You have got a pet, haven't you? 🐦🎵

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🐕 SARAH: (11:20)
Hi guys! I've got a dog. His name is Nelson and he's 3 years old. He is very big with golden fur. I take him for walks in the park every day. Does anyone else like dogs? 🐕

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🐈 LEO: (12:05)
I've got a cat! Her name is Luna. She is very clever and loves to play with toys. She sleeps on my bed every night. She's a bit noisy at 3 AM though... 🐈😴

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🐹 MIA: (13:15)
I have got two guinea pigs! Their names are Coco and Nibbles. They are so cute and fluffy! They eat vegetables and fruit. They are a bit messy though. You've got a pet too, haven't you? 🐹

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🐇 SAM: (14:30)
I've got a rabbit! Her name is Snowy because she is white like snow. She eats carrots and hay. She loves to run around the garden. Rabbits are the best pets, aren't they? 🐇

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🐠 EMMA: (15:45)
I haven't got a pet... 😭 But I want a goldfish! My parents say it's easy to take care of. What do you think, guys? 🐠

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💬 DAD: (16:00)
Hey everyone! Don't forget to clean your pets' cages! 😅

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💬 MUM: (16:05)
And feed them! 🍖

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💬 LEO: (16:10)
Oh no! I forgot to feed Luna! 🐈😅

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

days.title: Day 5: Tag-questions Practice
days.description: Тренируем разделительные вопросы с разными глаголами

grammar.title: Tag-questions — все случаи
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как образуются tag-questions**:

1️⃣ **to be**:
✅ It is cute, **isn't it?**
✅ They aren't noisy, **are they?**

2️⃣ **have got**:
✅ You have got a pet, **haven't you?**
✅ She hasn't got a dog, **has she?**

3️⃣ **Present Simple**:
✅ You like cats, **don't you?**
✅ She doesn't like dogs, **does she?**

📝 **Краткие ответы**:
✅ Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
✅ Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
✅ Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.

exercises.question: You like cats, ___ you? 🐈
exercises.explanation: You like cats (утверждение) → don't you? 🐈

exercises.question: She has got a dog, ___ she? 🐕
exercises.explanation: She has got a dog (утверждение) → hasn't she? 🐕

exercises.question: He doesn't like pets, does he? — Yes, he does.
exercises.explanation: He doesn't like pets (отрицание) → does he? (утвердительный вопрос). Ответ 'Yes, he does' правильный! 👍

exercises.question: They aren't noisy, ___ they? 🐹
exercises.explanation: They aren't noisy (отрицание) → are they? (утвердительный вопрос) 🐹

exercises.question: You like dogs, isn't it?
exercises.explanation: You like dogs (утверждение) → don't you? (не isn't it!) 🐕

days.title: Day 6: Writing — My Pet / My Dream Pet
days.description: Пишем текст о своём питомце или о питомце мечты

grammar.title: Повторение: описание питомца
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ What pet have you got? (Какой у тебя питомец?)
2️⃣ What is its name? (Как его/её зовут?)
3️⃣ What does it look like? (Как выглядит?)
4️⃣ What does it eat? (Что ест?)
5️⃣ What does it like to do? (Что любит делать?)
6️⃣ Why do you like it? (Почему ты его любишь?)

🎯 **Пример**:
I've got a cat. Her name is Luna. She is black and white. She eats cat food and sometimes fish. She likes to sleep on my bed. I like her because she is cute and funny! 🐈

exercises.question: I've got a ___ . (напиши питомца)
exercises.explanation: Напиши, какой у тебя питомец! 🐈

exercises.question: My pet's name is ___ . (напиши имя)
exercises.explanation: Напиши имя своего питомца! 🏷️

exercises.question: It has got ___ fur / feathers. (напиши цвет)
exercises.explanation: Какого цвета твой питомец? 🎨

exercises.question: It eats ___ . (напиши еду)
exercises.explanation: Что ест твой питомец? 🍖

exercises.question: I like my pet because it is ___ and ___ . (напиши два прилагательных)
exercises.explanation: Почему ты любишь своего питомца? Напиши два слова! 💖
